Name: Fish Slapper
Author: iwyxdxl
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Fish Slapper — Smack Your Catch or Dive In and Throw Hands[/b][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Tired of the peaceful fishing life? Choose violence.[/b][/size]

Fish Slapper is a lightweight SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that lets you deal with fish the [b]proper[/b] way. Why patiently reel a fish in when you can slap it silly? This mod gives you two options: give your catch a "welcome to my inventory" smack, or skip the rod entirely, dive into the river, and fight the fish face-to-face!

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/FishSlapDemo.gif[/img]


[size=4][b]🐟 Fish Slap (After Catch)[/b][/size]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/FishSlapDemo2.gif[/img]
[size=4][b]Show that carp who's boss! After successfully catching a fish, press the key to deliver a satisfying, celebratory slap. [/b][/size]
Watch your farmer perform a glorious punch-style animation complete with a little hop, impact particles, and a crisp "SMACK" sound effect.
A highly professional post-brawl summary will pop up, showing the player name, fish name, slap count, and your clear time.

[size=4][b]🌊 Dive Slap (During the Minigame)[/b][/size]
Losing the fishing minigame? Just jump in! Press the key during the minigame to dive straight into the water and throw hands with the fish directly.
Enjoy a fully animated sequence: dive in like a torpedo, swim to your target, unleash the slaps, and casually return to shore. Complete with custom sound effects and splash particles.
The fight's difficulty scales based on the fish's vanilla difficulty rating and movement pattern.

[size=4][b]✅ If you WIN: FATALITY.[/b][/size]
[b]You knock the fish out cold and get a triumphant HUD message showing your time and slap count.[/b]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/DiveSlapSuccess.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]❌ If you FAIL: Emotional Damage.[/b][/size]
[b]Turns out, fish have hands too. The fish fights back, slaps you instead, and leaves you publicly humiliated.[/b]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/DiveSlapFailure.gif[/img]

[size=4][b]⚖️ Balance Notes[/b][/size]
Street fighting takes energy! Each Dive Slap attempt costs [b]20 HP and 50 stamina[/b].
Also, because you are busy punching the fish in the face, you [b]cannot get treasure chests[/b] via Dive Slapping.

[size=4][b]⚙️ General Features[/b][/size]
Helpful on-screen key prompts appear while fishing (can be hidden in config).
Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support—rebind your slapping keys and toggle prompts directly in-game.
Available in English and Simplified Chinese!

[size=4][b]⌨️ Default Keybinds[/b][/size]
Fish Slap (After catch): [b]Right Mouse Button[/b] or [b]Space[/b]
Dive Slap (In minigame): [b]Q[/b]

[size=4][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley
SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
Generic Mod Config Menu (Optional, but highly recommended for easy config)

[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download the latest release of Fish Slapper.
3. Extract the [b]FishSlapper[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
4. Go slap some fish!

[size=4][b]💡 Open Source & Feedback[/b][/size]
This mod is open-source (MIT License).
Want to browse the code, report an issue, or contribute? Check out the GitHub repo:
https://github.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod


[center][size=6][b]Fish Slapper —给钓上来的鱼来两巴掌，或者下水PK！[/b][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]钓鱼太修身养性了？不如直接选择暴力！[/b][/size]

Fish Slapper 是一个给《星露谷物语》使用的轻量级 SMAPI 模组。谁说钓鱼只能老老实实收杆的？这个模组让你的农夫可以掌握两种“物理超度”鱼类的方法：要么等鱼上钩后给它两个大逼兜，要么干脆连杆都不要了，直接跳进水里跟鱼贴脸肉搏！

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/FishSlapDemo.gif[/img]


[size=4][b]🐟 钓上后扇鱼（钓到鱼之后）[/b][/size]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/FishSlapDemo2.gif[/img]
[size=3][b]既然咬了我的钩，就得挨我的巴掌！成功把鱼钓上来后，按下按键，顺手给它来一记响亮的耳光。[/b][/size]
角色会播放一套非常带感的动作：小跳起手、重拳出击，附带打击特效和清脆的“啪”声。
打完后还会弹出一份极具仪式感的战报，显示你的大名、鱼的名字、扇鱼次数和总用时。

[size=4][b]🌊 下水扇鱼（钓鱼小游戏中）[/b][/size]
不想玩烦人的钓鱼小游戏了？直接化身鱼雷！在钓鱼条小游戏过程中按下按键，角色会直接跃入水中，跟鱼来一场酣畅淋漓的1v1大战。
整套动作行云流水：跳水、游向目标、疯狂扇鱼、潇洒上岸。不仅有专属音效，还有水花四溅的粒子特效！
当然，鱼也不是吃素的，挑战难度会根据鱼本身的难度值和走位模式自动调整。

[size=4][b]✅ 如果你赢了：一拳KO！[/b][/size]
[b]你会直接把鱼拍晕带走，并在屏幕上看到显示用时和扇鱼次数的霸气提示。[/b]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/DiveSlapSuccess.gif[/img]
[size=4][b]
❌ 如果你输了：技不如鱼。[/b][/size]
[b]事实证明，鱼也是有脾气的。鱼会当场反杀，反过来狠狠给你一巴掌（物理打脸）。[/b]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod/main/docs/DiveSlapFailure.gif[/img]


[size=4][b]⚖️ 平衡设定（出来混是要还的）[/b][/size]
打架是个体力活：每次下水扇鱼需要消耗 [b]20 点生命值 和 50 点体力[/b]。
此外，因为你是去揍鱼的，没空摸鱼肚子里掉出来的东西，所以 [b]下水扇鱼无法获得宝箱奖励[/b]。

[size=4][b]⚙️ 通用功能[/b][/size]
钓鱼时屏幕上会贴心地显示按键提示（觉得碍眼可以在配置里关掉）。
可选支持 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] 模组，安装后可以直接在游戏内修改按键和开关提示。
自带英文和简体中文！

[size=4][b]⌨️ 默认按键[/b][/size]
钓上扇鱼（结算界面）：[b]鼠标右键[/b] 或 [b]空格键 (Space)[/b]
下水扇鱼（小游戏中）：[b]Q 键[/b]

[size=4][b]📦 运行需求[/b][/size]
《星露谷物语》原版游戏
SMAPI 4.0.0 或更高版本
Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，但强烈推荐，方便在游戏内调设置）

[size=4][b]🛠️ 安装方法[/b][/size]
1. 确保你已经安装了 SMAPI。
2. 下载本模组的最新版本。
3. 将解压出来的 [b]FishSlapper[/b] 文件夹直接丢进你的[b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] 目录中。
4. 打开游戏，找条鱼扇一顿！

[size=4][b]💡 开源与反馈[/b][/size]
本模组基于 MIT 协议开源。
如果你想看源码、提交 Bug，或者帮忙优化代码，欢迎访问 GitHub 仓库：
https://github.com/iwyxdxl/StardewValley_FishSlapper_Mod
